tenancy contest procedures**\n\nI’m looking at Swiss tenancy contest notice procedures, specifically Art. 273(1) which mentions a 30-day window from receipt for contesting. If someone seeks an extension, that also falls under Art. 273(2), with another 30 days from receipt of termination. If pursuing both an extension and a contest, they need to lodge it with the conciliation authority.
